description: This file defines the ReadOnlyFilesystemCache class in the Twig templating engine, which provides a filesystem cache that is read-only. It extends the FilesystemCache class and overrides the write method to prevent writing, enforcing a read-only behavior.

classes.name: ReadOnlyFilesystemCache
classes.description: A cache class that implements a read-only filesystem cache for Twig templates.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to prevent writing to cache, making the cache read-only.
